name: Claude Opus 5
archDisplay: Dense transformer, architecture undisclosed; adaptive thinking on by default, controlled by a runtime effort parameter (low/medium/high/xhigh/max)
note: Model id claude-opus-5 (released 2026-07-24, Anthropic's fourth Claude 5 model). Positioned as a thoughtful, proactive agent that 'comes close to the frontier intelligence of Claude Fable 5 at half the price' — same $5/$25 per MTok as Opus 4.8 (half of Fable 5's $10/$50); it is the new default model on Claude Max and the strongest model on Claude Pro. familySlug is claude-5, but predecessor is null: it is the first Opus in the Claude 5 family and cross-family predecessors are disallowed (Opus 4 likewise had a null predecessor at the start of Claude 4). Fast mode runs ~2.5x default speed at twice the base price ($10/$50). Per Anthropic's Opus 5 System Card (Table 8.1.A) it is state-of-the-art on FrontierBench v0.1 and GDPval-AA v2, roughly triples the next-best model on ARC-AGI-3, and ~1.5x the next-best on Zapier AutomationBench; it trails GPT-5.6 Sol on DeepSWE and ARC-AGI-2, and Fable 5 on SWE-bench Pro and FrontierCode. HLE headline uses the with-tools configuration (64.7%; no-tools is 56.3%) to stay ordering-consistent with the sibling Sonnet 5 row, whose corpus HLE figure (57.4%) is also with-tools. GDPval-AA v2 is deliberately NOT filed for this model: Opus 5's launch figure (1861) is on the current, re-fitted Artificial Analysis leaderboard (where Fable 5=1747, Opus 4.8=1593), whereas this corpus's gdpval-aa column is an earlier snapshot (Fable 5=1932, Opus 4.8=1890); mixing the two scales would make Opus 5 spuriously lose its GDPval-AA battles to Opus 4.8/Fable 5, contradicting the published SOTA result, so the row is omitted rather than corrupt the Elo. Cyber classifiers engage ~85% less often than Fable 5; flagged cyber/bio requests fall back to Opus 4.8 by default.

results.notes: AA-Briefcase (Artificial Analysis professional knowledge-work Elo), Claude Opus 5 System Card Table 8.1.A / §8.13.5. SOTA in row, ahead of Fable 5 (1574), GPT-5.6 Sol (1505) and Opus 4.8 (1346). All four values are from the same Anthropic run, so the scale is internally consistent.
ARC-AGI-1, Claude Opus 5 System Card Table 8.1.A (best effort). Tied with GPT-5.6 Sol (97.5, xhigh) in Anthropic's table; ahead of Opus 4.8 (92.5).
ARC-AGI-2, Claude Opus 5 System Card Table 8.1.A. Large jump over Opus 4.8 (72.1) but behind GPT-5.6 Sol (92.5).

ARC-AGI-3 (high effort), Claude Opus 5 System Card Table 8.1.A / §8.14.2. Anthropic's headline novel-reasoning result: ~3x the next-best model (GPT-5.6 Sol 7.8). Humans score ~100%; frontier AI was ~0.5% at the March 2026 launch, so this is a large SOTA jump.

Zapier AutomationBench (held-out private set), Claude Opus 5 System Card Table 8.1.A / §8.13.7. Anthropic reports ~1.5x the next-best model's pass rate for the same cost per task; Opus 5 topped Zapier's leaderboard.
BrowseComp (single-agent), Claude Opus 5 System Card Table 8.1.A. Beats Opus 4.8 (84.3), Fable 5 (87.4) and GPT-5.6 Sol (90.4).
CursorBench 3.2.0, Claude Opus 5 column of the Claude Fable 5.1 System Card Table 8.1.A. Run by Cursor rather than the model vendor.
DeepSearchQA F1, Claude Opus 5 column (max reasoning) of Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 launch scorecard.

DeepSWE v1.1 (113 long-horizon SWE tasks, mean over 5 trials), Claude Opus 5 System Card Table 8.1.A / §8.3. Ahead of Opus 4.8 (59.0) but behind Fable 5 (69.7) and GPT-5.6 Sol (72.7) — an honest non-SOTA row.

FrontierBench v0.1 (74 tasks, 7 domains), Terminal-Bench's successor: resolution rate 43.3%, rank 1 on the official leaderboard — surpasses all other models and more than doubles Opus 4.8's 21.1% (Fable 5 33.8, GPT-5.6 Sol 34.4). Cross-confirmed by the Claude Opus 5 System Card Table 8.1.A (43.3).
FrontierCode v1.1 Extended, Claude Opus 5 column of OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra launch comparison.

FrontierCode v1.1 (Main set), Cognition-run agentic coding, Claude Opus 5 System Card Table 8.1.A / §8.4. Opus 5 ranks 2nd (53.4 at medium effort), improving on Opus 4.8 (46.5) and leading GPT-5.6 Sol (47.5), just behind Fable 5 (53.5).
GDP.PDF, Claude Opus 5 column of Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash launch table.

HLE-Verified, Claude Opus 5 column of Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash launch table.

Humanity's Last Exam, WITH-tools configuration (no-tools is 56.3%), Claude Opus 5 System Card Table 8.1.A. With-tools chosen to match the sibling Sonnet 5 corpus figure (57.4%), also with-tools, keeping this mixed-config column's orderings correct.
JobBench, Claude Opus 5 column (max reasoning) of Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 launch scorecard; best in row.
LVBench, Claude Opus 5 column of Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash launch table.
